content.text:
I have enough to form a conclusion. Summary of the evidence so far:

- The only user-facing endpoint with a large slowdown is `POST /api/v1/adminuserservice/users` (about 82 → 285 ms at `ts-ui-dashboard`). Other dashboard endpoints are flat or faster.
- The extra time sits in `ts-admin-user-service` → `ts-user-service` `POST .../users/register` → `ts-auth-service` `POST /api/v1/auth`.
- Inside `ts-auth-service`, `AuthController.createDefaultUser` self-time grew by ~53 ms while its DB child is unchanged. Auth CPU is unchanged from normal, and its login path is unchanged.
- No restarts or memory changes appear on these pods, so this is not a resource or lifecycle fault.

I'll confirm the propagation edges with one more query that measures each caller-callee hop in both periods.
